list.title: Monthly Fluctuations:
list.snippet: While the overall annual rate was 8.0%, monthly inflation rates fluctuated throughout the year. For example, the index was up 7.5% in January and 6.5% in December.

list.title: Contributing Factors:
list.snippet: The surge in inflation was driven by several factors, including rising energy prices, particularly gasoline, and increases in food and housing costs.

list.title: Historical Context:
list.snippet: This 8.0% increase was the highest seen in decades, marking a significant period of rising prices.

text_blocks.snippet: In 2022, the United States experienced a significant surge in inflation, reaching its highest level in four decades. Several factors contributed to this surge, including pandemic-related disruptions to supply chains, increased consumer demand, and the war in Ukraine.

list.title: Peak Inflation:
list.snippet: The annual inflation rate peaked in June 2022 at 9.1%, the highest since 1981.

list.title: Broad-Based Increases:
list.snippet: Inflation was not limited to specific sectors; it was widespread, affecting various goods and services.
Food: Food prices saw substantial increases, with some categories like eggs experiencing dramatic price hikes due to factors like avian flu outbreaks.
Energy: Energy prices, particularly gasoline, surged, reaching levels not seen in decades.
Goods: Prices of goods, including durable goods, saw significant increases, partly due to supply chain bottlenecks and increased consumer demand for goods.

list.title: Global Context:
list.snippet: The US inflation surge was part of a broader global trend of rising inflation following the COVID-19 pandemic.

list.title: Policy Responses:
list.snippet: The Federal Reserve responded by raising interest rates to combat inflation, and the government also enacted the Inflation Reduction Act to address some of the underlying issues.

list.title: Decline in Inflation:
list.snippet: While inflation remained elevated throughout 2022, it began to moderate in the latter part of the year and continued to fall in 2023.
